'''2011 German National Championship Horst Knepper DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Horst Knepper]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Set Your Course 4 Euro Worlds
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
